cpmwheel.title: Animation wheel
cpmwheel.hint: Mouse: choose • Click/release: play • Right click: favorite/back • Scroll: page or value • Esc: back • 1-9
cpmwheel.nocpm: Customizable Player Models is not installed
cpmwheel.edit.title: Organize wheel
cpmwheel.edit.label: Label
cpmwheel.edit.select: Drag an animation from the list onto a slot. Click a slot to edit it, drag slots to swap, drag a slot to the list to clear it.
cpmwheel.edit.help: Right click list item: preview • Right click slot: favorite • Scroll on wheel: page
cpmwheel.icons.title: Choose icon
cpmwheel.icons.search: search item id or file name...
cpmwheel.value.hint.presets: Click: next preset • Scroll: fine adjust
cpmwheel.frames.title: Frames: %s
cpmwheel.frames.name: Frame %s name
cpmwheel.frames.help: Blank value = spread evenly between Min and Max • ▶ plays the frame • Color: swatch (cycle, last = none)
cpmwheel.value.hint.frames: Scroll: ±1 frame • Click: next frame • Click an outer segment: that frame
cpmwheel.hud.title: CPM Wheel HUD
cpmwheel.hud.keyhint: Toggle key: Controls > CPM Wheel > Toggle CPM HUD (default H)
cpmwheel.set.title: CPM Wheel – Settings
cpmwheel.group.title: Group: %s
cpmwheel.group.help: Click name: tick • Click action: cycle (right = back) • Value: click/scroll (frames by name). 1st click applies, 2nd restores.
cpmwheel.edit.key.help: Works without the wheel open; ignored while a GUI or chat is open.
cpmwheel.cond.title: Conditional: %s
cpmwheel.cond.l.name: Name contains
cpmwheel.fp.help: Makes the first-person arm show CPM layer/value animations (e.g. bracelet emotions). 'All' also applies gestures/poses, which may bend the arm oddly.
cpmwheel.glow.help: Glowing CPM parts on the first-person hand disappear with some shader packs. Emissive: always draw them with an emissive entity type in the hand. Auto: only while an Iris shader pack is active.
cpmwheel.ha.title: Hand animations (1st person)
cpmwheel.ha.st.nohand: hand event not received (another mod cancels the hand?)
cpmwheel.adj.title: Item in hand adjust
cpmwheel.adj.help: Hold an item of the chosen type and tune with this screen open: the hand shows behind. Values add to the built-in default.
cpmwheel.arm.title: Arm adjust (1st person)
cpmwheel.io.title: Per item / mod adjust
cpmwheel.worldarm.help: Draws the first-person arm together with the world's entities, the way Better Combat does, so CPM glow (emission) works with shaders like in third person. OFF = old method (hand pass). 'Only with shaders' = only while an Iris shader pack is active. Pauses by itself while Better Combat animates the arms.
cpmwheel.set.tip.worlddepth: Only for 'Render arm like Better Combat': pulls the arm toward the camera (lower = clips less into walls). Its size on screen does not change.
cpmwheel.worldarm.st.error: State: error, back to the old method this session (see log)
cpmwheel.io.mode.help: Priority: item > group > whole mod > item type > default. Groups join several items of a mod (e.g. every backpack) so you adjust them once.
cpmwheel.io.filter.help: With own setting: ★ items (typing searches everything). Same mod: only items of the chosen item's mod. Inheriting: items without their own setting that use a group's or the mod's.
cpmwheel.io.suggest.help: Groups found automatically in the mod: same id ending (*_backpack), same item class or same tag.
cpmwheel.io.reset.help: Reset to inherited: removes only this level's setting (this hand, item or arm) and goes back to the group / mod / type one.
cpmwheel.io.copy.help: Copy this setting to… another item, a group or the whole mod (this hand or both).
cpmwheel.io.empty.item: nothing here: type to search or change the filter
cpmwheel.io.empty.group: no groups: use + Group or Suggestions
cpmwheel.grp.name.label: Group name
cpmwheel.grp.mod.label: Mod (namespace) — empty = any mod
cpmwheel.grp.kind.help: Name search: type part of the name (see syntax below). Id pattern: * = any text, ? = one char (e.g. *backpack* or sophisticatedbackpacks:*backpack*); start with re: for a regex. Class: the item's Java class name. Tag: e.g. #c:backpacks. List: only the items added with the button.
cpmwheel.grp.value.label: Pattern / class / tag
cpmwheel.grp.addheld.help: Adds or removes the item in your main hand to/from the group's extra items.
cpmwheel.sug.title: Suggested groups
cpmwheel.sug.none: No groups found in this mod.
cpmwheel.sug.nomod: Type the mod (e.g. sophisticatedbackpacks) or hold one of its items.
cpmwheel.copy.title: Copy setting to…
cpmwheel.copy.head: Copy setting (%s) to…
cpmwheel.eff.title: Effect triggers
cpmwheel.eff.master.help: Turns every effect trigger on/off. Turning it off while something is active restores everything.
cpmwheel.eff.add.help: Creates a rule: when an effect starts, switch wheel buttons; when it ends, back to normal.
cpmwheel.eff.on.help: Turns only this rule on or off.
cpmwheel.eff.effect.help: Click to pick from every effect in the game, modded ones too.
cpmwheel.eff.end.help: Restore: each animation goes back to exactly its previous value (also on death or milk). If you change something by hand during the effect, your choice stays.
cpmwheel.eff.delaystart.help: The effect must be active this long before the rule acts.
cpmwheel.eff.delayend.help: Waits this long without the effect before restoring (avoids flicker if the effect drops and comes back).
cpmwheel.eff.notify.help: Shows the notice (toast) with icon, name and what changed when the rule starts and ends.
cpmwheel.eff.test.help: Pretends the effect is active for 5 seconds, then restores as if the effect ended.
cpmwheel.eff.addaction.help: Pick a group, a wheel button (emote/toggle) or any CPM animation.
cpmwheel.eff.op.help: ON switches on (group: applies the group). OFF switches off (group: the opposite of the group). TOGGLE flips the current state.
cpmwheel.eff.empty: No rules yet. E.g. Poison → OFF the Human group: the disguise drops while poisoned and comes back when it ends.
cpmwheel.eff.tpick.none: No buttons or animations found (is the CPM model loaded?).
cpmwheel.set.resetsec.help: Restore section defaults: only this section's options go back to default.
cpmwheel.set.cat.wheel.help: How the wheel opens and behaves, hotkeys and sounds.
cpmwheel.set.cat.style.help: Design, colours, icons and wheel center (with preview).
cpmwheel.set.cat.hud.help: On-screen list of what is active.
cpmwheel.set.cat.fp.help: Arm, glow/emission, held items and hand animations.
cpmwheel.set.cat.items.help: Per item, item group and mod adjustments.
cpmwheel.set.cat.effects.help: Switch things when an effect starts and restore when it ends.
cpmwheel.set.cat.compat.help: Better Combat, Hold My Items and other first-person mods.
cpmwheel.set.cat.advanced.help: Layout presets, model profile and old screens.
cpmwheel.set.tip.hold: Hold: the wheel closes when you release the key. Toggle: one press opens, another closes.
cpmwheel.set.tip.preview: Hovering a button really plays it on your model (CPM has no local-only preview).
cpmwheel.set.tip.favpage: Shows an extra page with the buttons marked as favourite.
cpmwheel.set.tip.ring: Inner ring with favourites and recently used.
cpmwheel.set.tip.alt: Alt+1..9 plays buttons 1..9 of the current page without opening the wheel.
cpmwheel.set.tip.framesegs: Frames buttons show each frame as a piece of the segment.
cpmwheel.set.tip.design: Wheel design. Click to change; the preview is on the side.
cpmwheel.set.tip.icononly: Buttons show only the icon, no text.
cpmwheel.set.tip.center: What the wheel center shows: your character, only the icon, or nothing.
cpmwheel.set.tip.centericononly: The center shows only the hovered button's icon.
cpmwheel.set.tip.hudenabled: Shows what is active on screen (default key H).
cpmwheel.set.tip.hudnondefault: Lists only what differs from default.
cpmwheel.set.tip.hudgrouped: Groups by wheel and folder with coloured bars.
cpmwheel.set.tip.hudempty: Shows groups even with nothing active.
cpmwheel.set.tip.hamaster: Turns every first-person hand animation on/off (breathing, bob, inertia, poses...).
cpmwheel.set.tip.link.handanim: Each hand animation, intensities and conflicts.
cpmwheel.set.tip.link.adjust: Item position in the hand by type (sword, block, lantern...).
cpmwheel.set.tip.link.armadj: First-person arm position, rotation and size, per hand.
cpmwheel.set.tip.itemson: Uses the per item, group and mod settings.
cpmwheel.set.tip.link.items: Per item, item group or whole mod adjust, for the item and for the arm.
cpmwheel.set.tip.vanilla: Item in the vanilla position (the arm stays CPM's).
cpmwheel.set.tip.twohand: Blocks held with one or both hands.
cpmwheel.set.tip.link.effects: Rules: when an effect starts, switch buttons; when it ends, restore.
cpmwheel.set.tip.ignore: Ignore conflict: use hand animations even with that mod (may double animations).
cpmwheel.set.tip.presetsave: Saves the wheel pages as a preset.
cpmwheel.set.tip.presetload: Pick a preset (click to cycle) and load it.
cpmwheel.set.tip.copydefault: Copies the default profile's pages into this model's profile.
cpmwheel.set.tip.link.hud: The previous HUD screen (same options as the HUD tab).
cpmwheel.grp.save.help: Saves the group and opens its position adjustment right away.
cpmwheel.grp.step1.help: Which mod to search in. "All mods" searches the whole game.
cpmwheel.grp.step2: 2) What the item name must contain
cpmwheel.grp.step2.help: Type part of the name, e.g. backpack. Matches netherite_backpack, iron_backpack… Use | for "or" (backpack | bag). Two words separated by a space = the name must have both.
cpmwheel.grp.step3.help: Items whose name has these words are left out. E.g. upgrade removes backpack upgrades. Separate several with spaces.
cpmwheel.grp.names.help: On: also searches the name shown in game, in your language. Off: only the item id (e.g. netherite_backpack).
cpmwheel.grp.adv.help: Shows other ways to build the group (pattern with *, regex, tag, class, list) and the full search syntax.
cpmwheel.grp.adv.text: Search syntax: space = AND (iron backpack: needs both) · | = OR (backpack | bag) · -word or !word = leave out (backpack -upgrade) · @mod = only that mod (@sophisticatedbackpacks backpack, @a|b for several) · $word = same as word · with : it compares the full id (minecraft:lantern). Other kinds: pattern *backpack* (? = 1 letter) or re:.*_backpack$ (regex); tag #c:backpacks; class BackpackItem; list = only items added with ± Held item.
cpmwheel.grp.help.short: Click an item to leave it out or bring it back.
cpmwheel.grp.none: No items found. Pick the mod and type part of the name, or click an example.
cpmwheel.grp.color.help: Group colour in the list (click to change).
cpmwheel.phys.title: Hanging physics
cpmwheel.phys.btn.help: Hanging physics: the item swings in the hand like a lantern (turning, walking, jumping, falling, stopping).
cpmwheel.phys.on.help: Turns it on or off for this target and hand only. Off here beats group/mod/type.
cpmwheel.phys.p.backpack.help: Heavy backpack: slow, small swing, feels jumps and stops.
cpmwheel.phys.p.keychain.help: Light keychain: fast, loose, big swing, hangs from the top.
cpmwheel.phys.pivot.help: Handle: swings around the hand, like a lantern. Top: swings around a point above the item, like something on a string.
cpmwheel.phys.intensity.help: How much camera movement and walking push the item.
cpmwheel.phys.stiff.help: Force pulling it back. More = faster, shorter swing.
cpmwheel.phys.damp.help: How fast the swing dies out (x10). Low = keeps swinging for a long time.
cpmwheel.phys.weight.help: Heavy items react slower and swing more calmly.
cpmwheel.phys.react.help: How much jumping, falling, landing, starting and stopping swing the item (0 = like the old lantern).
cpmwheel.phys.reset.help: Removes the own setting; goes back to group/mod/type.
cpmwheel.phys.kick.help: Gives it a push to see the effect (hold the item).
cpmwheel.phys.help: Hold the item to see it live on the right. Turn, walk and jump to test. Applies to the chosen item, group, mod or type (priority: item > group > mod > type), per hand. The "Lantern swing" animation option turns it all on/off.
cpmwheel.hudedit.title: Move HUD
cpmwheel.hudedit.help: Drag each box · mouse wheel = size · right click = reset · Shift = no snapping
cpmwheel.hudedit.snap.help: Snaps to the edges, the screen centre and an 8 px grid. Hold Shift to move freely.
cpmwheel.hudedit.resetall.help: Puts every element back to its default position and size.
cpmwheel.hud.move.help: Edit mode: drag the HUD elements with the mouse, wheel = size. Also has its own key in Controls (unbound by default).
cpmwheel.toast.on.help: Shows a notice when an effect trigger starts and ends (each rule also has its own switch).
cpmwheel.toast.mini.help: After the duration the notice shrinks to a row with the icon and the effect's time bar until it ends.
cpmwheel.toast.sample.title: Poisoned demon
cpmwheel.eff.lock.help: Lock buttons while active: wheel buttons (and groups) with this rule's animations get a padlock and do nothing until the effect ends, so the restore always goes back to the pre-trigger state.
